notes: f = oracle frame; each frame is exactly 1000/60 ms of virtual time
positions are world space before the vertex-shader world bend (bendX/bendY)
entity_spawn: f = frame added to the scene; pos/rot/scale/meshes captured at captured_f (first frame-end where the pooled root is no longer parked at z=9999); spawn_body = physics body at f
chunk_despawn = last entity mounted by that chunk was removed (chunks themselves are pooled, not destroyed)
entity chunk_via: mount = spawned inside Chunk.mount, z = attributed by world z
autopilot inputs appear as event kind=input (at = frame the keydown fires); replay them to reproduce the run
